summary: From fiscal 2010 to 2025, Walmart Inc. reported $8,591.1 billion of revenue and $239.9 billion of free cash flow. Stock pay was $17.6 billion, which leaves $222.2 billion of owner cash: 2.6% of revenue.
Owner cash was under 3.0% of revenue in 10 of 16 years.
In the latest fiscal year, to 2026-01-31, it was 1.6% of revenue.
